checks.check: A1 antiperiodic on both cycles: S(t) = S(1/t) for every profile, so the square is stationary
A2 the square is the only minimum on the rectangular family (S rises monotonically away from t = 1), four profiles
A3 the minimum is non-degenerate (positive curvature in log t)
A4 leading term: area times lambda_1^2 = pi^2 (t + 1/t), smallest at the square
B1 periodic on both cycles: the square is a maximum with a kink (both one-sided slopes point down)
B2 antiperiodic on one cycle only: no symmetry t -> 1/t and no stationary point at the square
C1 twisting the square (tau = x + i) lowers the action on both sides, with a kink: the square is a saddle among all tori
D1 the quarter turn maps the momenta of the modes to themselves at the square and not at t = 1.1, 2, 3
E1 four marks on the circle have a real cross ratio and give tau = i t; the map angle -> t is monotone
E2 t = 1 exactly for the marks at the fourth roots of unity (cross ratio 1/2)
